title: Select and Include
description: Optimize queries with select and include to fetch exactly the data you need.

data.text: By default, Prisma returns all scalar fields for a model. The `select` and `include` options let you control exactly which fields and relations are returned, reducing payload size and improving query performance.

items: **select** — Pick specific fields to return. Everything else is excluded.
**include** — Return all scalar fields plus the specified relations.

data.title: Select Specific Fields
data.content: Fetch only the id, name, and email of users.

data.title: Include Relations
data.content: Fetch posts with their author relation.

data.title: Performance Tip
data.text: Use `select` for API responses where you only need a subset of fields. Use `include` when you need all scalar fields plus related data.
